scoring_justification: Full recomputation from raw DFT outputs is infeasible because the verifier sandbox cannot re-run expensive DFT calculations; only the final reported energies are available. We safely compare reported values against hidden paper-reported QE energies with tolerance and trend ordering.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold segregation energies and Vo formation energies from the paper's QE calculations
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Segregation energies: Table 3(a) QE column ΔE_rel: LaO no Vo → -0.40 eV; Table 3(b) QE ΔE_rel: FeO2 no Vo → -0.42 eV; text in Section 3: 'the energy releases during the Pd segregation … are –0.21 and –0.89 eV in LaO- and FeO₂-terminated surface, respectively.' Vo formation energies: text in Section 3: 'V_O tends to form … with the formation energy of 2.89 and 1.42 eV, respectively.'
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed directly from the paper's reported QE numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported results; they serve as the hidden gold for a reproduction task using the same DFT code/settings.

outputs.description: Relative segregation energies (E_sol(1st) - E_sol(3rd)) for the four Pd/surface configurations: LaO without Vo, LaO with Vo, FeO2 without Vo, FeO2 with Vo.
Oxygen vacancy formation energies for the most stable Vo site near the Pd-substituted surface of each termination.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the reported values to hidden paper-reported Quantum ESPRESSO results with an absolute tolerance and verify the expected trend ordering.
